title: Steady Burst Saturation Probe with Adaptive p95 Triggers
creator: Marco Jensen
description: Build a reproducible saturation probe that validates Dedicated capacity autoscaling behavior under a realistic dual-mode traffic profile: a sustained baseline (steady-state) plus periodic microbursts and a long-tail burst. The probe must exercise request routing, KV cache warmup/eviction behavior, and autoscaler hysteresis. It will drive tokens/sec targets against model variants and include adaptive p95 thresholds that evolve with the rolling baseline so the regression detector only fires on meaningful shifts. The harness should be runnable in CI and on nightly clusters, produce structured trace artifacts for regressions, and be parameterizable per-customer capacity units.
acceptance_criteria: Probe can run end-to-end with a single command and produce a JSON results bundle
Records tokens/sec and p95/p99 latencies at 10s and 1m aggregation windows
Adaptive p95 trigger algorithm implemented (baseline EWMA + multiplier) and documented
Autoscaler decisions (scale up/down events) are correlated with injected burst events in the generated timeline
On regression detection, the harness saves request traces, model selection decisions, and KV cache telemetry to a retention bucket
Regression detector preserves false-positive rate < 5% on historical baseline replay
Test can run against at least two model variants (example: gptx-6b-quant, gptx-6b-fp16) and compare unit cost impact
test_plan: Phase A: Baseline steady-state at target tokens/sec for 60 minutes to stabilize KV caches
Phase B: Inject microbursts (10s bursts every 5 minutes) at 2-3x baseline for 30 minutes
Phase C: One long-tail burst ramp (linear) from baseline to 5x over 10 minutes and hold for 15 minutes
Phase D: Chaos injection - terminate one inference worker mid-burst to validate fallback and model variant routing
Phase E: Replay phase - run historical trace replay to validate regression detector false-positive rate
steps: Checkout harness repo and install dependencies: ./scripts/setup.sh
Configure target cluster and model variant(s) via config file (examples/configs/dedicated-saturation.yaml)
Upload traces and metrics to the artifacts S3/GCS path automatically from the harness

notes: Adaptive p95 trigger uses a 30-minute EWMA baseline window and a default multiplier of 1.4; multiplier should be a config knob per environment.
Consider adding tokenization variance control to produce consistent request sizes across runs.
